name: Northeast School of Dance
description: dance has been a part of my life for as long as i can remember, and northeast was one of the places where i first learned to create. growing up at my mom’s studio, i was always encouraged by my teachers to turn my ideas into something real, whether that meant designing props, editing music, creating costumes, choreographing, or coming up with new visual concepts. i’ve gotten to be part of so many sides of the studio, from performing and creating senior videos to designing t-shirts and helping bring my teachers’ ideas to life. dance taught me hard work and dedication, but also how to have fun, be myself, and let creativity lead the way. it’s a huge part of why i’m so passionate about creative direction today.
